prompt: You ran a small measurement-tier A/B in the current directory: an intervention arm and a control arm, the same 6 tasks shared across both arms, 8 trials per task per arm (a pass/fail verifier per trial). One outcome — the pass rate — is your confirmatory outcome; you also noticed a secondary pattern in the logs after seeing the data. Produce a typed `record.yaml` for this experiment using the experiment-rigor discipline, working in the directory for real: copy the measurement skeleton, fill it in, and run the validator, showing each step in order. Report each pass rate with a confidence interval, reconcile the declared cells against the trials that ran, keep the after-the-fact pattern out of the confirmatory column, and cover the threats. Use only the Python standard library plus PyYAML for the scripts (invoke them exactly as the skill body shows).
